description: Window cleaning inside gated Belvedere, five miles down Hamilton Pool Rd. Pure water, water fed poles up to three stories, about $10 per window.
h1_em: Gated estates, glass without a streak.
intro: Belvedere is a gated estate community about five miles down Hamilton Pool Road, with roughly 500 lots on one to three acres. CleanzATX cleans the large custom homes here with pure water and gate ready scheduling.

paragraphs: Belvedere is made for people who want room. There are around 500 lots, most between one and three acres, with custom homes of 3,000 to 6,500 square feet priced from about $1.5M to $3M. A 75 to 80 acre nature preserve sits inside the community, and the amenities include a lazy river pool and fishing ponds. The community is gated and has its own Belvedere HOA. Homes tend to be designed for entertaining, with tall ceilings, big sliders, covered porches and stone elevations, so the glass count is high.
Mature trees and the preserve make streets feel more like a wooded ranch than a subdivision.

With preserve land on one side and ponds on another, Belvedere sees more insects, webs and leaf litter than a typical suburb. Cedar pollen hits hard between December and February, and live oak pollen follows in spring. Irrigation on acre lots often runs long, which leaves hard water scale on lower windows and the base of tall doors. Limestone dust and gravel drive grit also settles on glass near entries. West facing windows toward the sunset show every streak.
Interior glass matters here too, because large ceilings put smudges and dust on the highest panes where they are hard to reach with a cloth.

Gates are part of the job. Send us your gate code or tell us who to call, and we confirm arrival by text. Once inside, water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so the tall exteriors are covered without ladders against stone. For tall interior glass we use ladders with cotton covers and drop cloths, and everything is hand squeegeed. Because Belvedere is a drive from Bee Cave, we group stops on the same road to save time, which is why booking with a neighbor helps. Houses this size often add a soft wash for stucco and limestone, plus gutters for one, two and three stories at $1.50, $2.25 and $3.25 per linear foot.
A 4,500 square foot home is about $450 for exterior windows. Plan on three and a half to four and a half hours outside, plus about two and a quarter hours inside.

faq.q: How do you get into Belvedere?
faq.a: Send us the gate code or the contact who can open it. You get a text from us when we head over. If there is a guest list, we give your management our name and the date range.

faq.q: Do you charge more for the drive out?
faq.a: No travel fee is published. Pricing is $10 per window or about $0.10 per square foot. Booking with a neighbor lets us group stops, which keeps scheduling easier for everyone.

faq.q: What about windows over a pool or pond?
faq.a: Water fed poles work from a safe distance, so we usually do not need to get close to the edge. We tell you ahead of time if a window needs another approach.

faq.q: Do you clean skylights and high interior glass?
faq.a: Yes, within what we can reach safely. Exterior glass up to three stories from the ground, and interior high windows with cotton covered ladders and drop cloths.

faq.q: Can you remove mineral buildup from irrigation?
faq.a: Removing hard water spots in Belvedere costs $10 per pane. We check the severity first, and on glass that has already etched, we explain what can and cannot be improved.

faq.q: Is a plan worth it for a home this size?
faq.a: Many owners pick Triannual (15% off) or Quarterly, which also include a free yearly screen cleaning and hard water removal on up to 5 windows each visit.
